download_youtube_video: download a YouTube video from a URL and save it to a specified output path
build_ydl_opts: build yt_dlp options dictionary for downloading videos with format and output template settings
run_download_cli: run the download_from_youtube CLI module to download a YouTube video by URL
create_video_download_script: create a script that downloads YouTube videos using yt_dlp with jsonargparse CLI interface
test_download_from_youtube: test the download_from_youtube module with a sample YouTube URL and output path
